dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。始めに、年齢と性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 6年　女
dialogue.English: 6th grade, female.

dialogue.content: しょうもないことなんですけど、、
dialogue.English: It’s kind of a small, silly thing, but...

dialogue.content: はい、どうされたのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Yes, what seems to be the matter?

dialogue.content: 昨日、AちゃんとBちゃんがCちゃんのことを話してて、AちゃんはCちゃんてこわいよね、って言ったらBちゃんはCちゃんやさしいよ、って言ったんです
dialogue.English: Yesterday, A and B were talking about C. A said, "C is kind of scary, don't you think?" and then B said, "No, C is nice."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 暗い話はしたくなくて、私はDちゃんに、Aちゃんっていい意味でうるさいよねーって言って、Aちゃんとこのゲームやってさぁ、Dちゃんはやってる？て話を変えたんです
dialogue.English: I didn't want the conversation to get gloomy, so I said to D, "A is loud in a good way, isn't she?" and then I changed the subject by asking, "I've been playing this game with A, do you play it?"

dialogue.content: なるほど、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そのあと、Aちゃんと通話する？ってLINEしてたんですけど返事がないです
dialogue.English: After that, I messaged A on LINE asking, "Want to have a call?" but I haven't gotten a reply.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。話がかみ合わずにモヤモヤしてしまいますよね。今のお話は、LINE上での会話と言うことかな？
dialogue.English: I see. It can feel unsettling when a conversation doesn’t quite connect, can't it? Was the conversation you just mentioned happening on LINE?

dialogue.content: いや、帰り道の話です
dialogue.English: No, it was on the way home.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。帰り道でみんなで話をしていて、その後に帰ってからAちゃんとLINE通話しようとしたら、返信がなかったということかな？
dialogue.English: I see. So, you were all talking on the way home, and then after you got home, you tried to set up a LINE call with A, but there was no reply. Is that right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだったんだね。Aちゃんからの返信がなくて気になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened. It must be worrying not to get a reply from A.

dialogue.content: 4人のお友達とはよく一緒にいるのかな？
dialogue.English: Are the four of you often together?

dialogue.content: はい。帰り道が一緒なので
dialogue.English: Yes, because we walk home together.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。話の内容が暗くなりそうだったから、話題を変えたくて話したことだったんだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you said that because you wanted to change the subject as the conversation seemed to be getting gloomy.

dialogue.content: そのことで、不安になってしまったのかなと感じましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I get the sense that this has made you feel anxious. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 返信がないと、そう感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way when you don't get a reply.

dialogue.content: 普段はAちゃんとはどんな感じかな？
dialogue.English: What is your relationship with A normally like?

dialogue.content: 大親友です
dialogue.English: We're best friends.

dialogue.content: 大親友、それは大切な存在なのですね。それは、より心配な気持ちになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Best friends, so she's a very important person to you. That must make you even more worried.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。これまでに、同じようなことはあったかな？
dialogue.English: I understand. Has anything like this happened before?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No, never.

dialogue.content: とても仲がいい関係なんですね。今、Aちゃんにどんな風に思っているかな？
dialogue.English: You have a very close relationship, then. What do you imagine A is thinking about you right now?

dialogue.content: 悪口だと思ってると思います、、
dialogue.English: I think she thinks I was badmouthing her...

dialogue.content: そう感じているんだね。そういうつもりじゃなかったのに、悲しいですよね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. It's sad when that wasn't your intention, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その場が悪くならないように、一生懸命だったんだと思います。他のお友達には、どんな風に感じているかな？
dialogue.English: I think you were trying your best to keep the atmosphere from getting unpleasant. How do you feel about your other friends?

dialogue.content: わかりずらくてごめんね。帰りがけに一緒にいたお友達です。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if that was unclear. I meant the friends you were with on the way home.

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。分かりにくくてごめんね。
dialogue.English: I see. Sorry for the confusion.

dialogue.content: Aちゃんは、大親友でとても大切なお友達だと思います。
dialogue.English: I can tell that A is your best friend and a very important person to you.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 悪口のつもりで言ってないことで、関係が崩れたらとても悲しいと思っているのかなと感じているのかなと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you feel it would be very sad if your relationship were damaged over something you didn't mean as bad-mouthing. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とても大切なお友達だから、大事にしたいと思っているからこそだと思います。返信がないということだけれど、これからどうしたいかな？
dialogue.English: I think it's precisely because she is such a precious friend that you want to cherish your relationship. You mentioned there's no reply, but what would you like to do from here?

dialogue.content: どうするのがいいですか？
dialogue.English: What's the best thing to do?

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていければと思いますが、いかかですか？
dialogue.English: I'd be happy to help you think it through together. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: たとえば、お友達が同じことで悩んでいたら、どんなアドバイスをするかな？
dialogue.English: For example, if a friend of yours were worried about the same thing, what advice would you give them?

dialogue.content: そんなつもりじゃなかったって話してみるのはどう？って
dialogue.English: I'd tell them, "How about talking to her and explaining that's not what you meant?"

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだよね。とてもいいアドバイスだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense. I think that’s very good advice.

dialogue.content: それを伝えられるようにしたいです
dialogue.English: I want to be able to tell her that.

dialogue.content: ほんとだね。そんな風に伝えられたらいいね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true. It would be great if you could tell her that.

dialogue.content: 今、イメージできるかな？
dialogue.English: Can you imagine it now?

dialogue.content: イメージ？
dialogue.English: Imagine?

dialogue.content: はいたとえば、一番伝えやすいのはどんな方法かな？
dialogue.English: Yes, for example, what would be the easiest way for you to tell her?

dialogue.content: 学校で一緒になったときに言う
dialogue.English: I'll tell her when we're together at school.

dialogue.content: いいね。その時に、どんな言葉で伝えられそうかな？
dialogue.English: That's a good idea. What words do you think you could use?

dialogue.content: 昨日はいい意味でうるさいって言ってごめんね。話を変えようと思って言ったんだけど、言い方がよくなかったと思う
dialogue.English: "I'm sorry for what I said yesterday about you being 'loud in a good way.' I only said it to try and change the subject, but I don't think I said it in a good way."

dialogue.content: うんうん。とてもいいと思います。素直な気持ちが伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: Yes, yes. I think that's excellent. Your sincere feelings really come through.

dialogue.content: 伝えられるようがんばります！
dialogue.English: I'll do my best to tell her!

dialogue.content: はい！私も応援しています！
dialogue.English: Yes! I'll be rooting for you!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 大親友がいて、その友だちを大切にしているお気持ちを聞けて、とても胸が熱くなりました。
dialogue.English: It was very heartwarming to hear about your best friend and how much you cherish her.

dialogue.content: 大切だからこそ、不安な気持ちにもなるけれど、関係をよくしたいと思っているお気持ちをすてきだなと思います。
dialogue.English: It's precisely because she is so important that you feel anxious, but I think it's wonderful that you want to improve your relationship.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ひとつ、違う目線ですが、、返信がないことは、ただ返信する時間がないからかもしれない、ということもあるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Just to offer a different perspective... it's also possible that she hasn't replied simply because she hasn't had the time.

dialogue.content: 話をしてみて、いかがでしたか。他に話したいことはあるかな？
dialogue.English: How do you feel now that we've talked? Is there anything else you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です！ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I'm okay now! Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。では、終了のメッセージ送らせて頂きます。
dialogue.English: Thank you, as well. I'll go ahead and send the closing message now.

dialogue.content: また、いつでも来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。とても勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. This was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. Thank you very much.)
